component.name: PDF
component.summary: Read, fill in, sign and highlight PDFs

description.p: A PDF is a piece of paper. Good Input PDF shows it as one, with nothing in the way, and keeps the few things you do with paper close at hand.

ul.li: Read, with every page at a glance and search across the whole file
Fill in forms, one field after the next
Sign with a signature you draw once and keep on your computer
Highlight in four colours that any PDF reader shows

description.p: The first build: opening, pages, search, forms, highlights, signatures and saving.
